verdicts.reason: The top-level httpx.request signature has no extensions parameter, so the documented call raises TypeError; extensions are accepted by Request and client-level request methods instead.

code_citation.quote:
def request(
    method: str,
    url: URL | str,
    *,
    params: QueryParamTypes | None = None,
    content: RequestContent | None = None,
    data: RequestData | None = None,
    files: RequestFiles | None = None,
    json: typing.Any | None = None,
    headers: HeaderTypes | None = None,
    cookies: CookieTypes | None = None,
    auth: AuthTypes | None = None,
    proxy: ProxyTypes | None = None,
    timeout: TimeoutTypes = DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_CONFIG,
    follow_redirects: bool = False,
    verify: ssl.SSLContext | str | bool = True,
    trust_env: bool = True,
) -> Response:

verdicts.suggested_doc_fix: Use a client instance when passing extensions, e.g. `with httpx.Client() as client: response = client.request("CONNECT", "https://www.example.com", extensions=extensions)`.
